excluded_models.reason: Arctic-Embed 2.0 large is initialized from bge-m3-retromae (BAAI, Beijing). AGENTS.md excludes BGE and its fine-tunes. Source: Arctic-Embed 2.0 paper, arXiv:2412.04506, section 2.1.
Arctic-Embed 2.0 medium is initialized from Alibaba gte-multilingual-mlm-base. AGENTS.md excludes GTE and its fine-tunes. Same paper, section 2.1.

granite-english-r2.lineage: ModernBERT architecture (Answer.AI, US, and LightOn, France), trained by IBM. No PRC base model. English R2 (Aug 2025, 149M) is still the newest English Granite embedder; the May 2026 multilingual R2 models are a different, multilingual line.
